prompt:

Asset type: Square food photograph for a premium Spanish food-rescue mobile webapp; reusable as a circular category thumbnail and rectangular food donation card.

Style/medium: Highly realistic appetizing premium studio food photography, tangible natural textures, commercial quality.

Lighting/mood: Soft broad studio light from upper left, gentle warm highlights, soft contact shadows directly beneath food; calm welcoming and fresh.
Color palette: Natural ingredient colors on the exact warm cream backdrop, no dramatic saturated backdrop.
Text: None.
Constraints: One cohesive arrangement, realistic food proportions, no typography, no logos, no labels, no brands, no watermark, no emojis, no people or hands, no chicken-brand buckets, no restaurant branding, no props unrelated to the specified food.
Primary request: A compact abundant arrangement of seasonal tropical fruit.
Subject: A small bunch of yellow bananas, one ripe mango, one orange, one green apple, and a few red strawberries. Arrange fresh whole fruit together with one subtle cut mango slice revealing golden flesh, no bowls or baskets.
